qa_pairs.question: Where is component C304 located according to the manual?
qa_pairs.answer: Component C304 is located at the base of the left 'B' pillar.

qa_pairs.question: What fuel system components are shown below the right side of the rear seat?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel tank sender (C360) and auxiliary fuel pump (G7839A) are shown below the right side of the rear seat.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find the main fuel pump in the vehicle?
qa_pairs.answer: The main fuel pump is located below the left rear of the car, forward of the rear wheel.

qa_pairs.question: What components are identified below the left side of the rear seat?
qa_pairs.answer: Components G300 and C352 are identified below the left side of the rear seat.

qa_pairs.question: Where is component C303 positioned in the vehicle?
qa_pairs.answer: Component C303 is positioned at the base of the right 'B' pillar.

qa_pairs.question: What component is located at the right rear of the rear differential?
qa_pairs.answer: The speedometer sender is located at the right rear of the rear differential.

qa_pairs.question: What is the page number and section title for this component location reference?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 7000-11 from the Component Location Views section.
